title: GM Plans Major Factory Automation Expansion
summary: General Motors plans a major increase in factory robotics on a tight timeline targeting 2028.

title: Stepped-Roof University Wins World Building of the Year
summary: Prestige University by Sanjay Puri Architects won the World Building of the Year award for its stepped roof design.

title: Four Companies Form Dual-Use Space Mission Partnership
summary: Simera Sense, Spacemanic, Zaitra and World from Space signed an MOU to cooperate on complete dual-use space missions.

title: SoftBank Acquires Robotics and AI Institute
summary: SoftBank completed its acquisition of the Robotics and AI Institute from Hyundai Motor Group to expand its portfolio.

title: Russia Launches Progress 97 Cargo Ship to ISS
summary: Russia launched the robotic Progress 97 freighter toward the International Space Station from Kazakhstan.

title: £2M Investment Kickstarts Welsh Tidal Turbine Project
summary: A £2M investment from the North Wales Clean Energy Fund will help fund construction of a tidal turbine off Anglesey.

title: Voice AI Systems Struggle With Kenyan Speech and Code-Switching
summary: Researchers and startups in Kenya are working to bridge a generalization gap in voice AI caused by spontaneous code-switching, dynamic Sheng slang, dialects, and background noise.

title: Ordinary Metal Hides New Form of Magnetism
summary: Scientists discovered a strange form of magnetism in an ordinary metal that changes electron behavior.

title: Foldable 84-Key Piano Fits in a Backpack
summary: Pliavo’s Fold-and-Go Piano features a keyboard that splits into hinged sections for easy portable travel.

title: Microsoft Powers Up First AMD Helios AI System
summary: Azure plans to deploy the new AMD Helios rack-scale system at scale to support AI inference.

title: Report Urges Recognizing Waterways as National Infrastructure
summary: A new report says Britain's navigable waterways must be recognized as vital infrastructure requiring sustained investment.

title: Research Boost for FDSOI and RF-SOI Semiconductors
summary: Acorn Technologies and Prof Jean-Pierre Raskin demonstrated results using the Acorn Buried Stressor technology.

title: EnSilica Secures $80M GNSS ASIC Contract
summary: EnSilica has agreed to develop a custom GNSS ASIC for a resilient positioning, navigation, and timing systems supplier.

title: U.S. Building Only 10% of Needed Power Lines
summary: Experts warn that the U.S. grid is falling behind as electricity demand rises, building just 10% of necessary high-voltage lines.

title: 3D-Printed Carbon Black Sensors Improve Piezoresistive Performance
summary: Researchers investigated carbon black and Ecoflex nanocomposite sensors fabricated using a 3D printing-assisted technique to enhance piezoresistive performance.

title: Theoretical Study Explores Plastic Shot Blasting
summary: Researchers analyzed plastic shot blasting as a surface hardening method for metals that minimizes roughness and avoids microcracks.

title: Potatoes Grown in Simulated Lunar Dust
summary: Researchers have successfully grown potatoes in simulated lunar regolith, potentially enabling future moon base farming.

title: Hybrid-Bonded 3D NAND Boosts In-Memory Compute Density
summary: Researchers from IBM, Micron, and the University of Patras published a paper on a hybrid-bonded 3D-NAND-flash-based analog in-memory-compute macro.

title: Kleox Reveals Tiny Expanding Teardrop Camper Trailer
summary: Kleox has developed an all-new expanding teardrop trailer that measures under 10 feet long and stretches out at camp to sleep two people.

title: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs with MoOP
summary: Researchers proposed MoOP, a VLM pruning method that reduces parameters while retaining reasoning and driving performance.

title: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Robot Control
summary: ACAP is an asynchronous framework organizing a robot as a team of persistent agents to improve control efficiency.

title: Tropical Geometry-Based Lyapunov Function Synthesis
summary: A new framework uses tropical geometry to jointly synthesize neural network Lyapunov functions and stabilizing controllers.

title: Embo-Harness Framework for Frontier Model Policies
summary: Embo-Harness studies and evaluates frontier multimodal models serving directly as policies within closed-loop robotic agentic loops.

title: Formalised Framework for Analog Electronics in Lean 4
summary: Researchers present a formalised framework for circuit theory and analog electronics using the Lean 4 interactive theorem prover.

title: ConfID: Data-Driven Identification of Uncertainty Sets
summary: ConfID is a unified framework that establishes reachset, trace, and simulation conformance by identifying uncertainty sets for nominal models.

title: WeaveVLA 3D Relational Grounding for VLA Models
summary: WeaveVLA enhances VLA action generation by explicitly modeling task-relevant relative 3D relations and maintaining relational context across observations.

title: RUIBench: Evaluating Robot-Use Interfaces for Agents
summary: RUIBench introduces 30 manipulation tasks across five suites to systematically study the impact of robot-use interfaces on agent reliability.

title: NoveltyGate Accelerates VLA Prefix Computations
summary: NoveltyGate is a training-free method that routes prefix tokens to low-rank or original MLPs based on input novelty to accelerate VLA models.

title: Real2Worlds2Real Agentic Real2Sim2Real Framework
summary: Real2Worlds2Real is an agentic framework that integrates scalable simulation-world construction with policy development for robot manipulation.

title: Marginal-Cost Clustering for Courier Dispatch Routing
summary: A marginal-cost clustering criterion improves courier dispatch for pickup and delivery problems with time windows and fleet sizing.
